_comment: Single source of truth for every generated badge in this directory. NOT a shields endpoint. Add an entry here only when its report is actually live in the registry; tools/update_badges.py regenerates audits.json, screened.json and the per-entry badges from this file, so the published counts cannot run ahead of the published reports. Methodology pages are listed separately and deliberately carry no badge.

entries.note: By-construction verdict with no arrival column in the delivered data, so there are no measured signal-cycles to count. The badge deliberately carries no number rather than borrowing one from the positive control or from the characteristic count.

methodologyPages.title: SEC EDGAR as-filed US panel
methodologyPages.note: Screened 84 signal-cycles across 14 signals; 28 flagged, 7 of 14 signals clean. Not a registry entry, so its cycles do not enter screened.json.
